0022600197.text: The Pistons host the Los Angeles Lakers in their 9th game of the season, sitting 6-2 and first in the Central and third in the East, though they come off a loss after a 6-2 stretch over their last ten. The Lakers are 8-2, first in the Pacific and third in the West, on a four-game win streak, and Luka Doncic is listed as day-to-day with a back injury and is a game-time decision. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Pistons swept the 2025-26 series 2-0, most recently beating the Lakers 113-110 in Detroit on March 23.
